findings.description: When ANSI stripping applies, the added `.strip()` also removes all leading and trailing whitespace from the prompt, not just the escape codes the title describes.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a prompt on a non-TTY stream where stripping applies, for example prompt('Name') whose text ends in ': ' after suffix construction. Mechanism: `strip_ansi(text).strip()` drops the trailing space, so the prompt is written as 'Name:' instead of 'Name: '. Impact: the prompt output differs from the unstripped case by a trailing space, and the input text is not separated from the prompt. Only ANSI removal was announced, so this extra whitespace change is unintended.
